At the time Lojban was baselined, there were some who were loudly in favour of there being an official Language Academy instituted to do the sort of stuff a Language Academy does. This idea was explicitly quashed by [[Lojban Central]] at the time.
*[[User:Nick Nicholas|nitcion]]:
*:The [[BPFK|baupla fuzykamni]] which the Board is currently finalizing discussion on (more info when it does finalize it) is closer to an Academy - although, as a commission, its mandate is circumscribed. It is not a [[jboske]]ist body, although it will clearly need to consult with jboskeists.
